system.description:
You can strike nearby opponents in an amazing, spinning melee attack.

Prerequisites: Dexterity 13, Intelligence 13, Melee Defense, Base Attack Bonus +4

Effect: As a Full-Round Action, you can make an Area Attack with your melee weapon, striking every target within your reach. This Whirlwind Attack uses the Area Attack rules; you make one attack roll and apply the result to every target in range.
